outcomeNote: Mishna rulings; segment 100b.8 is the chapter-closing הדרן formula

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמְּנָחוֹת וְהַנְּסָכִים שֶׁנִּטְמְאוּ, עַד שֶׁלֹּא קָדְשׁוּ בִּכְלִי – יֵשׁ לָהֶם פִּדְיוֹן; מִשֶּׁקָּדְשׁוּ בִּכְלִי – אֵין לָהֶם פִּדְיוֹן.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «the» fine flour for «meal offerings or the» wine for «libations that became ritually impure,» as long as they «have not yet been consecrated in» a service «vessel» and assumed inherent sanctity, «their redemption» is possible. If they are redeemed, their sanctity will be transferred to the redemption money. «Once they have been consecrated in» a service «vessel» and have assumed inherent sanctity, «their redemption» is «no» longer possible, and they are burned like any other offerings that became ritually impure.

segments.he: הָעוֹפוֹת וְהָעֵצִים וְהַלְּבוֹנָה וּכְלֵי שָׁרֵת, מִשֶּׁנִּטְמְאוּ – אֵין לָהֶן פִּדְיוֹן, שֶׁלֹּא נֶאֱמַר פִּדְיוֹן אֶלָּא בִּבְהֵמָה.
segments.en: With regard to consecrated «birds, wood» for the altar, «frankincense, and service vessels, once» they «became ritually impure they have no» possibility of «redemption, as redemption» of items consecrated for the altar «was stated only with regard to» a consecrated «animal» that developed a blemish, not with regard to other consecrated items.

moves.summary: Impure meal offerings and libations are redeemable before sanctification in a vessel, not after
Impure birds, wood, frankincense and service vessels are not redeemable, since redemption is stated only for an animal

positions.claim: meal offerings and libations that became impure may be redeemed before sanctification in a service vessel, not after
birds, wood, frankincense and service vessels that became impure cannot be redeemed
positions.basis: redemption was stated only regarding an animal
